label: Endorsed by the practice's own standards: P.OwnStandard m: the practice's own authoritative…
term: endorsed by the practice's own standards
definition: `P.OwnStandard m`: the practice's own authoritative standards endorse m as a correct move, as opposed to a standard imported from outside the practice (a philosopher's, a scientist's).
note: Analytical vocabulary (#1010). Which instances count as the practice's own standards is not fixed here; for the Catholic practice the open bridge STMT-CONCILIAR-DEFINITION-IS-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD counts conciliar definitions among them.
